saathiNoAudio: Audio not recorded yet for this language. Read the script aloud instead.
saathiTranscript: Hello, this is Inspector Vijay from the CBI cyber cell, Mumbai. A parcel in your name with illegal drugs was seized. An arrest warrant has been issued. Stay on this video call and do not tell anyone in your family. To prove you are innocent, transfer your savings to the RBI verification account now.
saathiRule1: Police never question anyone on a video call.
saathiRule2: No officer asks you to stay on a call to "stay safe", or to move money.
saathiRule3: Hang up, and call your family.

kLink: The link, copied without opening it
linkI: Paste the link. It is examined on this device and is not opened or sent anywhere.
lkBad: This does not look like a web link.
lkNone: No warning sign found in the address itself. That does not mean the site is safe.
lkGov: The address ends in gov.in or nic.in, used for Indian government sites. Check that it is the site you meant.
lkName: It uses the name of a bank, agency or service. Compare it letter by letter with the official address.
lkShort: A short link hides where it really goes.
lkApk: It downloads an app file (APK). Do not install it.
lkIp: It uses a number in place of a website name.
lkLook: It contains special letters that can imitate a real name.
lkAt: The text before @ is not the real site.
lkSub: The address is long. The last part of the name decides the real site.
remL: Date and time to follow up
remEv: Follow up on cyber fraud complaint
remN: Check your complaint on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. Contact your bank.

scam.0.s: A caller posing as police or CBI says you are in a case and must stay on video.
scam.0.a: Hang up. Tell your family. No arrest happens over a video call.
scam.1.s: A parcel in your name was seized and a fee will settle it.
scam.1.a: Do not pay. Check with the courier on its official website.
scam.2.s: Your account or SIM will be blocked today unless you update KYC through a link.
scam.2.a: Do not open the link. Visit your bank or operator.
scam.3.s: Power will be cut tonight; call this personal number and pay.
scam.3.a: Check your bill in the electricity board's official app or office.
scam.4.s: Earn by liking videos or rating places, then pay a deposit to unlock more.
scam.4.a: Stop. Do not pay a deposit to get a job.
scam.5.s: Scan this code or approve this request to receive money.
scam.5.a: You never need your UPI PIN to receive money.
scam.6.s: A chat group promises assured high returns through its own app.
scam.6.a: Do not invest. Assured high returns are a warning sign.
scam.7.s: A new number says your child or relative needs money urgently.
scam.7.a: Call the person on their saved number. Ask the family code word.
quiz.0.m: Dear customer, your electricity will be disconnected at 9:30 tonight. Call 98XXXXXX10 immediately.
quiz.0.w: A deadline tonight and a personal mobile number are warning signs.
quiz.1.m: Your statement for October is ready in the bank app. Never share your PIN with anyone.
quiz.1.w: It asks for no money, link or secret. Still open the app yourself.
quiz.2.m: You have won a cashback. Enter your UPI PIN to receive the money.
quiz.2.w: Receiving money never needs your UPI PIN.
quiz.3.m: Mum, this is my new number. My phone broke. Send money urgently, I will explain later.
quiz.3.w: Call the saved number before doing anything.
quiz.4.m: Your appointment is confirmed for Monday at 10 am. No payment is needed now.
quiz.4.w: No pressure, payment or secret is involved.
quiz.5.m: This is the police. Stay on video and move your money to a safe account for checking.
quiz.5.w: No officer asks you to move money to a safe account.
faq.0.a: No. It helps you prepare. You report to 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in yourself.
faq.1.q: Does this app file my complaint?
faq.1.a: No. It writes the text. Nothing is filed until you do it.
faq.2.q: Will I get my money back?
faq.2.a: There is no guarantee. Report quickly to improve the chance of a hold.
faq.3.q: I do not have all the details.
faq.3.a: Call anyway. Share what you know and add the rest later.
faq.4.q: What happens if I close this tab?
faq.4.a: Your case is erased. Copy or print what you need first.
word.0: An address for payments, like name@bank.
word.1: The 12-digit reference number of a UPI payment.
word.2: A one-time code sent to your phone.
aiPrivacy: The optional AI wording receives only the result level, the scam type and the names of the matched rules. It never receives your message.
